description: A relational classifier determines how a given collection/field viewpoint participates in a relation definition. When the viewpoint matches the owning side without polymorphic markers it is a many-to-one. When the viewpoint matches the related side and names the relation's reverse field it is a one-to-many. When the viewpoint matches neither side the result is reported as none. The request supplies a relation definition together with the collection and field forming the viewpoint, and the relationship kind is reported.
